$comment: Known-violations allowlist for the axe baseline-ratchet gate (rule-id level). Each entry is deferred AA work with a milestone, not an accepted defect — the list only shrinks. The gate fails on any violation whose rule id is NOT here.

allow.reason: Dimmed inline markers, code-block syntax tokens, and link colors fail AA contrast (8 elements). The editor now owns its theme tokens (editor-theme.css, guarded by G4.6), so this is no longer unfixable here — it is unfixed: the dim palette is a deliberate visual choice that has not been reconciled with AA. Fixing it means re-tuning the token values, not moving them.
allow.milestone: unscheduled — needs a palette pass, not a migration

allow.reason: Editable blocks (role=textbox: paragraphs, headings, code) have no accessible name. The per-block naming model is a consequence of the editor-root a11y-structure decision and is best settled against the integrated surface where focus/navigation semantics are real.

The thematic break uses a focusable role=separator, which axe treats as a slider-style separator requiring aria-valuenow/min/max. The focusable-separator semantics need rework (likely a different role or a non-focusable treatment).
